Data.Name: Place wrench on lug bolt 1
Data.Description: Snap the wrench onto the highlighted first lug bolt.

Data.Name: Loosen lug bolt 1
Data.Description: Turn the snapped wrench counterclockwise one full turn. Then grab the wrench and lift it off the bolt.

Data.Name: Loosen lug bolt 2
Data.Description: Lift the wrench off bolt 1, snap it onto the next highlighted bolt, then turn it counterclockwise one full turn.

Data.Name: Loosen lug bolt 3
Data.Description: Lift the wrench off bolt 2, snap it onto the next highlighted bolt, then turn it counterclockwise one full turn.

Data.Name: Loosen lug bolt 4
Data.Description: Lift the wrench off bolt 3, snap it onto the next highlighted bolt, then turn it counterclockwise one full turn.

Data.Name: Loosen lug bolt 5
Data.Description: Lift the wrench off bolt 4, snap it onto the next highlighted bolt, then turn it counterclockwise one full turn.

Data.Name: Unscrew lug nut 1
Data.Description: Turn the wrench counterclockwise one more full turn on lug nut 1. Let the nut fall, then continue to the next nut.

Data.Name: Unscrew lug nut 2
Data.Description: Turn the wrench counterclockwise one more full turn on lug nut 2. Let the nut fall, then continue to the next nut.

Data.Name: Unscrew lug nut 3
Data.Description: Turn the wrench counterclockwise one more full turn on lug nut 3. Let the nut fall, then continue to the next nut.

Data.Name: Unscrew lug nut 4
Data.Description: Turn the wrench counterclockwise one more full turn on lug nut 4. Let the nut fall, then continue to the next nut.

Data.Name: Unscrew lug nut 5
Data.Description: Turn the wrench counterclockwise one more full turn on lug nut 5. Let the nut fall, then continue to the next nut.

Data.Name: Take off wheel
Data.Description: The five lug nuts are off. Grab the highlighted WheelWithNut wheel, move it away from the car, and release it. It will fall to the ground.
